title: Abandoned Put goroutine can leak and may still write the segment later
notes: A store Put that ignores its context and never returns: worker.put returns on ctx.Done but the goroutine and the open file handle stay until the Put returns, which may be never. A Posix-like store whose Put ignores ctx can also finish later and rename the segment into place after the job was cancelled (written by a non-owner; no DB record, so harmless to correctness but visible in the store).
